title: Lighting up word retrieval: A scoping review of fNIRS studies on lexical access in healthy and neurodegenerative populations
title_zh: “点亮”词汇提取：健康与神经退行性疾病人群中fNIRS研究的范围综述
abstract: Lexical access is a fundamental process in language production, commonly investigated using verbal fluency (VF) and rapid automatized naming (RAN) paradigms. Despite its clinical relevance, especially in neurodegenerative disorders, cortical mechanisms supporting lexical access remain poorly understood. Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) enables the investigation of task-evoked cortical dynamics during overt speech, yet the literature has lacked a systematic mapping. This scoping review summarizes current research practices and findings to inform methodological refinement and clinical translation. A structured search of MEDLINE, Embase, PsycINFO, and Web of Science identified 30 eligible English-language original studies that used continuous-wave commercial fNIRS to study lexical-access tasks in healthy subjects and/or people with neurodegenerative disorders. Publication volume increased markedly after 2012 and was conducted predominantly in Asia. Verbal Fluency was the only paradigm employed, and no studies investigated RAN with fNIRS. Protocols predominantly used block designs with 30 or 60 s of active task blocks interleaved with rest and/or control blocks. Cortical coverage focused primarily on the prefrontal cortex, with less consistent sampling of broader configurations. Preprocessing and modelling pipelines showed substantial heterogeneity; HbO-based amplitude outcomes and block-averaging approaches predominated. The fNIRS literature on lexical access in healthy subjects and neurodegenerative cohorts is currently based on VF tasks and focused on the PFC, with limited methodological standardization. Future studies should diversify paradigms, expand network-level coverage, and harmonize methodologies and analysis practices to support clinical translation.
abstract_zh: 词汇提取是语言生成中的基础过程，常通过言语流畅性（VF）和快速命名（RAN）范式进行研究。尽管其临床相关性尤其在神经退行性疾病中突出，但支持词汇提取的皮层机制仍了解有限。功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）可在有声言语任务中研究任务诱发的皮层动力学，但该文献缺乏系统映射。该范围综述总结了当前研究实践与发现，以指导方法学优化和临床转化。我们对MEDLINE、Embase、PsycINFO和Web of Science进行结构化检索，筛选出30项符合条件的英文原创研究，这些研究使用连续波商业化fNIRS在健康受试者和/或神经退行性障碍人群中研究词汇提取任务。2012年后发表量明显上升，且研究主要在亚洲开展。仅使用了言语流畅性范式，未有研究采用fNIRS研究RAN。研究方案主要使用方块设计：30或60秒的任务方块与休息和/或对照方块交替。皮层覆盖主要集中在前额叶皮层（PFC），更广泛网络构型采样不够一致。预处理与建模流程呈现显著异质性；以HbO振幅为基础的结果和方块平均方法占主导。目前关于健康受试者和神经退行性队列的词汇提取fNIRS文献，主要基于VF任务并聚焦PFC，方法学标准化有限。未来研究应多样化范式、扩展网络级覆盖，并协调方法学和分析实践，以支持临床转化。
